overview_description.description: Arta Finance is a digital wealth platform that helps accredited investors manage and grow their assets across public and private markets. The company offers AI-managed portfolios, robo and direct indexing strategies, and customized equity and options-based solutions. Members can access alternative investments such as private equity, private credit, real estate, venture capital, and hedge funds. Arta Finance also provides products like High-Yield Cash Reserve, structured investments, and tax-focused life insurance solutions under WealthGen. Additional services include tax and estate planning support, derivatives-based hedging and income strategies, and a digital community experience for learning and events.
